```{r setup, include = FALSE}

                      fig.align = "center")

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(nflreadr)
library(gt)
library(googlesheets4)
```

# Overview

Each team has an **offense rating** (points scored above an average team) and a
**defense rating** (points prevented). Before every game the model predicts both
teams' scores from those ratings, adjusted for home field, backup quarterbacks and
wind. After the game, ratings move toward what actually happened, using a blend of
the final score and offensive EPA. The rest of the current season is then simulated
10,000 times to estimate each team's final record and playoff chances.

This report tunes the model and saves its parameters to `params.csv`. The weekly
GitHub Actions run (`update.R`) reuses those parameters, so rerun this report only
when the model changes or once per offseason. All shared functions live in
`R/functions.R`.

Use the **Code** buttons to show or hide the R code for each step.

# Setup

```{r settings}
source("R/functions.R")

current       <- most_recent_season()
seasons       <- 2015:current
train_seasons <- 2017:2022   # 2015-16 are rating warm-up
test_seasons  <- 2023:2025
n_sims        <- 10000
export_sheets <- FALSE       # TRUE to also write the dashboard tabs from this report

# Table styling
shades <- c("#f7fbff", "#c6dbef", "#6baed6", "#2171b5", "#08306b")   # light = unlikely, dark = likely

nice_tbl <- function(df, title, decimals = 2, ...) {
  df |>
    gt(...) |>
    tab_header(title = title) |>
    fmt_number(columns = where(is.double), decimals = decimals) |>
    opt_row_striping() |>
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(13), heading.align = "left",
                heading.title.font.weight = "bold")
}

big_tbl_options <- function(tbl) {
  tab_options(tbl, table.font.size = px(12), heading.align = "left",
              heading.title.font.weight = "bold")
}
```

# Data

One row per regular-season game, with each team's offensive EPA and a pregame
backup-QB flag (a QB who started fewer than half of his team's last 4 games). EPA is
converted to "points it was worth" with a regression fit on the training seasons
only, so it can be blended with actual points.

```{r data}
games   <- build_games(seasons)
p_scale <- fit_epa_scale(games, train_seasons)
games   <- add_epa_pts(games, p_scale)
```

# Rating model

## Tuning

Parameters are chosen to minimize margin RMSE + total RMSE on the training seasons.
`sd_margin` doesn't affect the ratings, so it is fit afterwards with a probit model,
which picks the spread that gives the best win probabilities.

```{r tuning}
score_params <- function(p, seasons = train_seasons) {
  g <- filter(run_ratings(games, p)$games, season %in% seasons, !is.na(margin))
  sqrt(mean((g$margin - g$pred_margin)^2)) + sqrt(mean((g$total - g$pred_total)^2))
}

start <- c(k = 0.08, w = 0.78, hfa = 1.35, regress = 0.40, qb = 3.5, wind = 0.13)
fit <- optim(start, \(x) score_params(c(as.list(x), p_scale, sd_margin = 13.5)),
             method = "L-BFGS-B",
             lower = c(0.01, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0),
             upper = c(0.40, 1, 4, 1, 10, 0.5))
p_best <- c(as.list(fit$par), p_scale)

# Probit slope = 1 / sd
res <- run_ratings(games, c(p_best, sd_margin = 13.5))
wp_fit <- glm(home_win ~ 0 + pred_margin, family = binomial(link = "probit"),
              data = filter(res$games, season %in% train_seasons, !is.na(margin), margin != 0))
p_best$sd_margin <- 1 / coef(wp_fit)[[1]]

res <- run_ratings(games, p_best)

tibble(parameter = names(p_best), value = unlist(p_best)) |>
  nice_tbl("Tuned parameters", decimals = 3)
```

## Current ratings

```{r ratings}
res$ratings |>
  nice_tbl("Team ratings (points vs. average team)") |>
  cols_label(team = "Team", off = "Offense", def = "Defense", net = "Net") |>
  data_color(columns = net, palette = c("#b2182b", "#f7f7f7", "#2166ac"),   # red = bad, blue = good
             domain = c(-1, 1) * max(abs(res$ratings$net)))
```

# Evaluation

## Model vs. Vegas

```{r evaluation}
evaluate <- function(games, seasons, vegas_sd = 13.5) {
  games |>
    filter(season %in% seasons, !is.na(margin), !is.na(spread_line)) |>
    mutate(vegas_wp = pnorm(spread_line / vegas_sd),
           won      = home_win == 1,          # positive class = home team wins
           pick     = home_wp  > 0.5,
           v_pick   = vegas_wp > 0.5) |>
    summarise(
      log_loss        = -mean(home_win * log(home_wp)  + (1 - home_win) * log(1 - home_wp)),
      vegas_log_loss  = -mean(home_win * log(vegas_wp) + (1 - home_win) * log(1 - vegas_wp)),
      mae_margin      = mean(abs(margin - pred_margin)),
      vegas_margin    = mean(abs(margin - spread_line)),
      mae_total       = mean(abs(total - pred_total)),
      vegas_total     = mean(abs(total - total_line)),
      accuracy        = mean(pick == won),
      vegas_accuracy  = mean(v_pick == won),
      precision       = sum(pick & won) / sum(pick),
      vegas_precision = sum(v_pick & won) / sum(v_pick),
      recall          = sum(pick & won) / sum(won),
      vegas_recall    = sum(v_pick & won) / sum(won)
    )
}

eval_tbl <- bind_rows(Train = evaluate(res$games, train_seasons),
                      Test  = evaluate(res$games, test_seasons), .id = "set")

eval_tbl |>
  select(set:vegas_total) |>
  nice_tbl("Model vs. Vegas: probabilities and scores (lower is better)", decimals = 3) |>
  cols_label(set = "", log_loss = "Model", vegas_log_loss = "Vegas",
             mae_margin = "Model", vegas_margin = "Vegas",
             mae_total = "Model", vegas_total = "Vegas") |>
  tab_spanner("Log loss",   c(log_loss, vegas_log_loss)) |>
  tab_spanner("Margin MAE", c(mae_margin, vegas_margin)) |>
  tab_spanner("Total MAE",  c(mae_total, vegas_total))

eval_tbl |>
  select(set, accuracy:vegas_recall) |>
  nice_tbl("Model vs. Vegas: picking winners (higher is better)") |>
  fmt_percent(columns = -set, decimals = 1) |>
  cols_label(set = "", accuracy = "Model", vegas_accuracy = "Vegas",
             precision = "Model", vegas_precision = "Vegas",
             recall = "Model", vegas_recall = "Vegas") |>
  tab_spanner("Accuracy",  c(accuracy, vegas_accuracy)) |>
  tab_spanner("Precision", c(precision, vegas_precision)) |>
  tab_spanner("Recall",    c(recall, vegas_recall)) |>
  tab_source_note("Precision and recall treat a home win as the positive class.")
```

## Where the model trails Vegas

Gap = model error − Vegas error, in points. Rerun after any model change.

```{r gap}
res$games |>
  filter(season %in% c(train_seasons, test_seasons), !is.na(margin), !is.na(spread_line)) |>
  mutate(gap        = abs(margin - pred_margin) - abs(margin - spread_line),
         week_grp   = cut(week, c(0, 4, 9, 14, 18), labels = c("1-4", "5-9", "10-14", "15-18")),
         any_backup = if_else(home_backup | away_backup, "Backup QB", "Starters")) |>
  summarise(n = n(), gap = mean(gap), .by = c(week_grp, any_backup)) |>
  arrange(week_grp, desc(any_backup)) |>
  nice_tbl("Gap to Vegas by part of season") |>
  cols_label(week_grp = "Weeks", any_backup = "QBs", n = "Games", gap = "Gap (pts)")
```

# Season simulation

## Remaining games

```{r remaining}
res$games |>
  filter(season == current, is.na(margin)) |>
  transmute(week = paste("Week", week), matchup = paste(away_team, "@", home_team),
            pred_margin, spread_line, pred_total, total_line, home_wp) |>
  nice_tbl("Predictions for remaining games", decimals = 1, groupname_col = "week") |>
  fmt_percent(columns = home_wp, decimals = 0) |>
  cols_label(matchup = "Game", pred_margin = "Model", spread_line = "Vegas",
             pred_total = "Model", total_line = "Vegas", home_wp = "Home win %") |>
  tab_spanner("Home margin", c(pred_margin, spread_line)) |>
  tab_spanner("Total points", c(pred_total, total_line))
```

## Resting starters in the final week

A team is treated as **locked** going into the final week if it is in playoff
position and no other team in its conference is within one game of it, so no
final-week result can change its seed. In the simulation, each locked team rests
its starting QB with the probability below, estimated from 2015–2025 using the same
definition. Resting applies the usual backup-QB penalty to that game only.

```{r resting}
rest_hist <- rest_history(res$games, 2015:2025)
p_best$p_rest <- mean(rest_hist$rested, na.rm = TRUE)

tibble(locked_teams = nrow(rest_hist), rested = sum(rest_hist$rested, na.rm = TRUE),
       rest_rate = p_best$p_rest) |>
  nice_tbl("Locked teams in the final week, 2015–2025") |>
  fmt_percent(columns = rest_rate, decimals = 0) |>
  cols_label(locked_teams = "Locked teams", rested = "Started a backup", rest_rate = "Rest rate")
```

## Monte Carlo

Each simulation plays out the remaining games in order. Each team's score is its
expected score plus normal noise (sd = `sd_margin` / √2, so the margin has sd
`sd_margin`), and ratings update after every simulated game, so a hot or cold
streak carries into later weeks. Before the final week, each simulation checks
which teams are locked and decides which of them rest their starters.

Standings use simplified tiebreakers: win %, then division record (for division
titles) or conference record (for wild cards), then random. The NFL also uses
head-to-head, common games and strength of victory, which this skips.

```{r simulate}
set.seed(2026)
sim  <- simulate_rest(res, current, n_sims, p_best)
tabs <- dashboard_tables(sim, res, current, n_sims)
```

# Backtest: simulating from week 10

For each of the last 10 seasons, the model is rerun as if it were the end of
week 10: later scores are hidden, and later backup-QB starts and wind are treated
as unknown. The rest of that season is then simulated and compared with what
actually happened.

- **Final wins:** projected wins vs. actual, compared with a simple *pace*
  projection (current win % × games in the season).
- **80% range:** how often the actual win total fell between the 10th and 90th
  percentile of the simulations (should be about 80%, a bit higher because wins
  are whole numbers).
- **Playoff Brier score:** squared error of the playoff probabilities (lower is
  better), compared with giving every team the league-wide playoff rate.

Seasons 2017–2022 were used to tune the parameters, so their results are slightly
optimistic. 2016 and 2023–2025 are a fully out-of-sample check.

```{r backtest, cache = TRUE}
post <- load_schedules(2016:2025) |> filter(game_type != "REG")
made_playoffs <- distinct(bind_rows(transmute(post, season, team = fix_team(home_team)),
                                    transmute(post, season, team = fix_team(away_team))))

backtest_season <- function(s, through_week = 10, n_sims = 2000) {
  g <- games |>
    filter(season <= s) |>
    mutate(future      = season == s & week > through_week,
           home_score  = replace(home_score, future, NA),
           away_score  = replace(away_score, future, NA),
           home_backup = home_backup & !future,   # later QB changes weren't known yet
           away_backup = away_backup & !future,
           wind        = replace(wind, future, 0))
  r        <- run_ratings(g, p_best)
  now      <- filter(r$games, season == s, !is.na(margin))
  gp_now   <- table(c(now$home_team, now$away_team))
  wins_now <- season_wins(now)
  n_games  <- if (s >= 2021) 17 else 16
  actual   <- season_wins(filter(res$games, season == s, !is.na(margin)))
  made     <- made_playoffs$team[made_playoffs$season == s]
  net_now  <- setNames(r$ratings$off + r$ratings$def, r$ratings$team)

  simulate_rest(r, s, n_sims, p_best)$stand |>
    summarise(proj_wins  = mean(w + t / 2),
              lo         = quantile(w + t / 2, 0.1),
              hi         = quantile(w + t / 2, 0.9),
              p_playoffs = mean(playoffs),
              .by = team) |>
    mutate(season      = s,
           n_games     = n_games,
           games_now   = as.numeric(gp_now[team]),
           wins_now    = wins_now[team],
           net_now     = net_now[team],
           pace_wins   = wins_now / games_now * n_games,
           actual_wins = actual[team],
           made        = team %in% made)
}

set.seed(2026)
bt <- bind_rows(lapply(2016:2025, backtest_season))

score_bt <- function(d, by = character(0)) {
  summarise(d,
            mae_model  = mean(abs(proj_wins - actual_wins)),
            mae_pace   = mean(abs(pace_wins - actual_wins)),
            coverage   = mean(actual_wins >= lo & actual_wins <= hi),
            brier      = mean((p_playoffs - made)^2),
            brier_base = mean((mean(made) - made)^2),
            .by = all_of(by))
}

bind_rows(mutate(score_bt(bt, "season"), season = as.character(season)),
          mutate(score_bt(bt), season = "All")) |>
  nice_tbl("Backtest from week 10, by season", decimals = 2) |>
  fmt_percent(columns = coverage, decimals = 0) |>
  cols_label(season = "Season", mae_model = "Model", mae_pace = "Pace",
             coverage = "80% range hit", brier = "Model", brier_base = "Base rate") |>
  tab_spanner("Final wins (MAE)", c(mae_model, mae_pace)) |>
  tab_spanner("Playoff Brier", c(brier, brier_base)) |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_body(rows = season == "All"))
```

Are the playoff probabilities themselves trustworthy? Teams are grouped by their
week-10 playoff odds and compared with how often they actually got in.

```{r backtest-calibration}
bt |>
  mutate(bin = cut(p_playoffs, c(0, 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1), include.lowest = TRUE)) |>
  summarise(teams = n(), predicted = mean(p_playoffs), actual = mean(made), .by = bin) |>
  arrange(bin) |>
  nice_tbl("Week-10 playoff odds vs. actual playoff rate") |>
  fmt_percent(columns = c(predicted, actual), decimals = 0) |>
  cols_label(bin = "Playoff odds", teams = "Teams", predicted = "Predicted", actual = "Actually made it")
```

### Bubble teams (30–70% at week 10)

Each bubble team is classified by whether its record at week 10 was better or worse
than its rating suggests (rating converted to a win % against an average team), and
by which way the model leaned. Comparing projected and actual win % over the rest of
the season shows whether misses came from the ratings (teams played differently than
expected) or from the playoff race itself (same wins, different outcome).

```{r bubble}
bubble <- bt |>
  filter(p_playoffs > 0.3, p_playoffs <= 0.7) |>
  mutate(rec_pct     = wins_now / games_now,
         rating_pct  = pnorm(net_now / p_best$sd_margin),
         type        = if_else(rec_pct > rating_pct, "Record better than rating",
                                                     "Rating better than record"),
         lean        = if_else(p_playoffs > 0.5, "Leaned in (50-70%)", "Leaned out (30-50%)"),
         rest_proj   = (proj_wins - wins_now) / (n_games - games_now),
         rest_actual = (actual_wins - wins_now) / (n_games - games_now))

bubble |>
  summarise(teams = n(), predicted = mean(p_playoffs), made = mean(made),
            rest_proj = mean(rest_proj), rest_actual = mean(rest_actual),
            .by = c(lean, type)) |>
  arrange(lean, type) |>
  nice_tbl("Bubble teams by type", groupname_col = "lean") |>
  fmt_percent(columns = -c(type, teams), decimals = 0) |>
  cols_label(type = "", teams = "Teams", predicted = "Predicted", made = "Made it",
             rest_proj = "Projected", rest_actual = "Actual") |>
  tab_spanner("Playoffs", c(predicted, made)) |>
  tab_spanner("Win % after week 10", c(rest_proj, rest_actual))

bubble |>
  arrange(desc(p_playoffs)) |>
  transmute(season = as.character(season), team,
            record = paste(wins_now, games_now - wins_now, sep = "-"),
            net_now, type, p_playoffs, proj_wins, actual_wins, made = if_else(made, "Yes", "No")) |>
  nice_tbl("Every bubble team", decimals = 1) |>
  fmt_percent(columns = p_playoffs, decimals = 0) |>
  cols_label(season = "Season", team = "Team", record = "Week-10 record", net_now = "Net rating",
             type = "", p_playoffs = "Playoff odds", proj_wins = "Proj. wins",
             actual_wins = "Actual wins", made = "Made it") |>
  data_color(columns = made, palette = c("#f4a582", "#92c5de"))
```


# Appendix: ideas tested

| Status | Idea | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Kept | Backup QB penalty | About 4 points of margin; cut the late-season gap to Vegas in half |
| Kept | Backup flag based on the last 4 games | New permanent starters stop counting as backups; better log loss on train and test |
| Kept | Resting starters (simulation only) | Locked playoff teams rest their QB in the final week at the historical rate |
| Kept | Wind | About −0.26 total points per mph |
| Rejected | Rest days, division games, dome, temperature | No effect |
| Rejected | Ahead on both O and D, balanced vs. lopsided edges, specialist vs. well-rounded teams | Made test-season predictions worse |
| Rejected | Extra volatility for lopsided teams | No effect |
| Parked | Special teams EPA rating | Coefficient 0.43, p = 0.04; small and uncertain |
| Parked | Separate update speed and regression for O and D | Not yet tested |
| Parked | Blend win-loss record into ratings | Backtest: record coefficient +0.18, p = 0.06; small |
| Parked | Larger backup penalty in weeks 15–18 | Late-season backup games still trail Vegas by about 0.75 points |
